connectorUiConfig.title: FullHunt Potential Phishing
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The [FullHunt](https://fullhunt.io) Potential Phishing data connector ingests potential phishing domains that may impersonate your monitored organizations, discovered from domain registrations and TLS certificates from the [FullHunt Enterprise API](https://docs.fullhunt.io) into Microsoft Sentinel. Requires the FullHunt **Dark Web Monitoring** module; without it the FullHunt API returns HTTP 403. The data connector is built on the Microsoft Sentinel Codeless Connector Framework.

sampleQueries.description: Latest FullHunt Potential Phishing records (deduplicated by RecordId)
sampleQueries.query:
FullHuntPotentialPhishing_CL
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by RecordId
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 10

sampleQueries.description: Potential phishing domains by discovery source (last 7 days)
sampleQueries.query:
FullHuntPotentialPhishing_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by RecordId
| summarize Domains = count() by RecordType

dataTypes.name: FullHuntPotentialPhishing_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
FullHuntPotentialPhishing_CL
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: Read and Write permissions are required.

customs.name: FullHunt Enterprise API key
customs.description: A FullHunt Enterprise account and its API key are required, with the Dark Web Monitoring module enabled. See the [FullHunt authentication documentation](https://docs.fullhunt.io/authentication).

instructionSteps.title: Connect FullHunt Potential Phishing to Microsoft Sentinel
instructionSteps.description: Copy your API key from your [FullHunt profile settings](https://fullhunt.io/user/settings/), then enter it below and select **Connect**. The connector polls FullHunt every 15 minutes.
